message: Evening, after finishing our sparring practice with everyone.

name: Asahi
message: 「Iori-sensei, we've returned.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Phew~ That was so much fun！」
Having finished changing, everyone filed back into the classroom.

name: Ririmu
message: 「Man, that was my first time seeing Secchan go berserk, and~」

name: Ririmu
message: 「That was hilarious！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Ah, well, I'm terribly embarrassed by my own shortcomings...」

name: Iori
message: 「Setsugekka, are you feeling alright？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Huh? Uh, yes, I'm managing just fine...」
After that, Setsugekka said she had a slight fever and headed to the infirmary.

name: Keisetsu
message: 「No need to worry, I was watching over her. Her temperature's back to normal now.」

name: Iori
message: 「I see, that's a relief.」
Last time, Setsugekka collapsed after going berserk, and when I went to check on her out of worry, I walked in on her masturbating.
So this time, I deliberately didn't go check on her.
Hmm, she's fidgeting about something...

name: Iori
message: 「Alright everyone, that's it for today's class！」

name: Iori
message: 「Does anyone have any final questions？」
As for Momiji, losing to me must have been quite a shock, because she hasn't uttered a single word since getting back to the classroom.

name: Ririmu
message: 「Don't sweat it so much~, Momicchi.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「None of us could beat Iorin anyway.」

name: Asahi
message: 「I'm sure this has shown you just how wonderful Iori-sensei is.」

name: Momiji
message: 「...I suppose so.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Well, I guess there might be a little something I can learn from Iori-sensei too.」
That sure is a loaded way of putting it...

name: Ririmu
message: 「Ooh, ooh~, Iorin, can I ask a question？」

name: Iori
message: 「Sure, ask away.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「What kind of classes are we going to be taking from now on？」

name: Iori
message: 「Good question, Ririmu.」
I had intended to explain it again tomorrow, but since she took the trouble to ask, I might as well talk about it now.

name: Iori
message: 「I’ll be preparing both a common curriculum and individual curriculums for you all.」

name: Iori
message: 「The common curriculum will involve the entire Takamura Class participating in lectures, basic physical training, and sparring practice between classmates.」

name: Iori
message: 「For the individual curriculum, I plan to assign training regimens tailored to each of your specific needs.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「……Wait a minute.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「The common curriculum involves the entire Takamura Class? Does that mean I’m expected to participate in this so-called basic physical training too?」

name: Iori
message: 「Yeah, of course.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Look, I’m not in the Martial Arts Division, you know？」

name: Iori
message: 「In other first-year classes, everyone does basic physical training and sparring practice, regardless of whether they’re in the Martial Arts, Technical, or Quartermaster divisions.」

name: Iori
message: 「It’s perfectly normal here at Murakumo Academy.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「I’m a scholarship student. It’s quite an inconvenience to be treated the same as ordinary students.」

name: Iori
message: 「That’s got nothing to do with me.」

name: Iori
message: 「I’ve decided that every student in the Takamura Class will be treated equally, no matter who they are.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「You really are painfully earnest……」

name: Iori
message: 「Besides, you’re a member of a warrior house, aren't you？ If you’re too frail, the other warriors won't follow your lead, you know？」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「W-well, I suppose that’s true, but……」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Whoa…… My big sister is actually losing an argument……」

name: Iori
message: 「More importantly, you promised that if something was important to Setsugekka, you’d go along with it, right?」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「……So, are you saying that my participating in basic physical training is one of those important things？」

name: Iori
message: 「Yeah, exactly.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「I see…… very well. I shall participate.」
Good, good. I’m glad she understood.

name: Momiji
message: 「……What was that just now？」

name: Iori
message: 「What do you mean... was there something strange about it？」

name: Momiji
message: 「Something like, if it’s important to Setsugekka, then we should get on board with it, or whatever.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Oh, I was curious about that too.」
Right, I hadn't told everyone about that yet.

name: Asahi
message: 「Iori-sensei, you were the one who said it the other day, weren't you?」

name: Asahi
message: 「That as a team, we should share everything—both our strengths and our weaknesses—and support one another while we polish our skills.」

name: Asahi
message: 「That that is the way to become the strongest in Murakumo Academy.」

name: Momiji
message: 「So, in other words, you’re saying we should all just get along and get stronger together？」

name: Asahi
message: 「If you summarize it, yes, that is what I mean.」
Upon hearing Asahi’s reply, Momiji’s expression turns sharp.

name: Momiji
message: 「...Hey, Iori-sensei. I want to confirm something.」

name: Iori
message: 「Ask me anything.」

name: Momiji
message: 「You know what we swordsmen are seeking at this academy, right？」

name: Iori
message: 「To become stronger, and to become a Toujinegi.」

name: Momiji
message: 「That's right, exactly.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Is there anyone here who’s going to say, ‘I’m not aiming to become a Toujinegi’？」
Momiji looks around the classroom.
No one raises an objection.

name: Momiji
message: 「In other words, everyone here wants to become the pinnacle of the academy, a Toujinegi.」

name: Momiji
message: 「And remind me, can just anyone become a Toujinegi？」

name: Iori
message: 「No, only one person in this entire academy can become a Toujinegi.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Yeah, yeah, exactly.」

name: Momiji
message: 「So, what’s this？ Are we supposed to be all buddy-buddy, holding hands, and aiming for first prize together？」

name: Momiji
message: 「That’s absurd, isn't it?」

name: Momiji
message: 「Only one single person among us can become a Toujinegi.」

name: Momiji
message: 「We’re rivals fighting over a single chair, and on stage, we’re nothing but enemies.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Asahi, do you have any objections to what I just said？」

name: Asahi
message: 「…No, I do not.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Exactly. We are each other’s enemies, aren’t we？」

name: Asahi
message: 「Yes, that’s right.」
Spurred on by Momiji, everyone’s gaze began to sharpen.

name: Momiji
message: 「Wait, then isn’t that strange？ What did you say earlier？」

name: Momiji
message: 「That sharing everything—the good and the bad—within a team and working hard to push each other to improve is the best way to become strong？」

name: Momiji
message: 「That’s absolutely impossible！」

name: Momiji
message: 「How to get the better of your opponent, how to catch them off guard」

name: Momiji
message: 「Always scheming and competing against each other」

name: Momiji
message: 「Giving your all to win in preparation for the battle to come」

name: Momiji
message: 「Isn’t that the way a swordsman should be？」

name: Momiji
message: 「If you share everything, how are you supposed to outwit your opponent？」
No one dared to challenge Momiji’s words.
Surely everyone in their hearts harbored the same doubts as Momiji.

name: Momiji
message: 「In our practice earlier, I learned that Iori-sensei certainly has real ability.」

name: Momiji
message: 「He probably sees things I can’t see yet, and I’m sure there’s something I can learn from him.」

name: Momiji
message: 「But that’s a completely different matter from this.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Sensei, I’ve felt uneasy about your teaching philosophy from the very start.」

name: Momiji
message: 「What is the point of everyone gathering in the classroom every morning？」

name: Momiji
message: 「What is the point of everyone attending the same classes？」

name: Momiji
message: 「What is the point of enemies acting all friendly？」

name: Momiji
message: 「Answer me, Iori-sensei.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Does the method you’re aiming for align with the principles of us swordsmen？」
It was a fundamental question.
If he couldn't provide a convincing answer to this current doubt, all the effort put in until now would be for nothing.
It would be equivalent to betraying their trust.
All the more reason.
I have to answer Momiji's question with my whole heart and soul.

name: Iori
message: 「First of all. Thank you, Momiji.」

name: Iori
message: 「I'm truly glad you were honest and brought your doubts straight to me.」
Questioning someone above you takes far more courage than people imagine.

name: Iori
message: 「My way of doing things probably isn't rational.」

name: Iori
message: 「It's true that Jindou is an individual sport, and even your classmates can become your opponents. You might even end up facing each other at the Martial Festival.」

name: Iori
message: 「What I'm aiming for might not be essential to growing stronger as a swordsman, or to becoming the Toujinegi.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Then... are you saying what you're aiming for is meaningless, Sensei？」
Eyes closed, a deep breath. I open them again and begin to speak.

name: Iori
message: 「I'm a graduate of this very school, Murakumo Academy.」

name: Iori
message: 「Back then, just like all of you now, I threw myself into my training at this academy, aiming to become the Toujinegi.」

name: Iori
message: 「Along the way, I made a friend I could call my best friend.」

name: Iori
message: 「He was crazy strong, too. We traded wins and losses, yelling and bickering the whole time as we pushed each other to get stronger.」

name: Iori
message: 「Yeah, we fought a lot, too.」

name: Iori
message: 「Even though we were swordsmen, we'd trade punches bare-handed. There were even times we both showed up to class with our faces completely swollen.」

name: Iori
message: 「Looking back on it now, it's nostalgic... They really are good memories.」
Only Asahi knows.
That I'm talking about her older brother.

name: Momiji
message: 「So in other words, we're just being dragged along to humor your sentimentality, Sensei？」

name: Iori
message: 「In a way, that might be true.」

name: Iori
message: 「Still, there are things you can only understand because you've walked the path ahead of others.」

name: Iori
message: 「Listen to me, Momiji.」

name: Iori
message: 「From here on, you're going to spend three irreplaceable years of your life at this academy.」

name: Iori
message: 「Once that time is gone, you can never get it back.」

name: Iori
message: 「Do you really intend to spend those precious three years all alone？」
Those who master the path of independence are surely peerlessly strong as swordsmen.
But it is a lonely path.
You could call it aloof and make it sound cool, but such a life is far too sad, and far too lonely.

name: Iori
message: 「In this academy, you have friends and rivals right here beside you, breathing the same air and working toward the same goals.」

name: Iori
message: 「Once you graduate, you will never get to experience such a time ever again.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Never... experience it again...」

name: Iori
message: 「Yes, that's right.」

name: Iori
message: 「After graduating from this academy, everyone will go their own separate ways.」

name: Iori
message: 「Some will become professional Jindou athletes.」

name: Iori
message: 「Others will surely forge ahead toward a future they've discovered for themselves.」

name: Iori
message: 「Everyone will drift apart.」

name: Iori
message: 「This is the last chance for all of us to stand side by side and do something together.」
I spread my arms wide, as if to reach from one end of the classroom to the other.

name: Iori
message: 「This place, this time, and these classmates beside you right now...」

name: Iori
message: 「...have the potential to become lifelong treasures for you.」

name: Iori
message: 「Whether or not they become treasures depends entirely on you.」
I look out at everyone, not just Momiji.

name: Iori
message: 「Setsugekka, Momiji, Asahi, Ririmu, and Keisetsu.」

name: Iori
message: 「You are all lucky. You have truly wonderful friends right beside you.」

name: Iori
message: 「Listen, whether you become a Toujinegi or not, life goes on.」

name: Iori
message: 「For the sake of the future that lies ahead, and more than anything, for the sake of this very moment right now...」

name: Iori
message: 「...please, cherish this time and the people around you.」

name: Iori
message: 「If you do, then surely... no, I am certain of it.」

name: Iori
message: 「When you look back on today, you will be able to say:」

name: Iori
message: 「That the three years spent at Murakumo Academy were the best time of my life！」

name: Iori
message: 「That I am who I am today because I had those friends by my side back then！！」

name: Iori
message: 「That！ That is exactly what I want to teach you all！」
The path to becoming a Toujinegi is a harsh one.
No matter how hard I try, I cannot make everyone here a Toujinegi.
So, if they lose, if they fail to achieve results, does everything become meaningless?
No, that’s wrong. It shouldn’t be.
If results were everything and nothing else held meaning, if all that mattered was the pursuit of strength, then having a personal trainer would suffice.
Then what are teachers for？ What is the point of a homeroom teacher？
Isn’t it to help them live healthy, fulfilling lives long after they’ve left this place?
That is what I believe the value of a teacher truly is.
I want to believe.
That a girl you just happened to sit next to at school might become a lifelong friend.
That it might become an irreplaceable treasure that supports you for the rest of your life, even after you’ve become an adult.
Yes, that is why it’s meaningful for everyone to be in the classroom together from the morning.
It is meaningful for everyone to take the same lessons together.
Even if they are enemies on the stage, there must be meaning in being on good terms—

name: Momiji
message: 「...Hah, what’s that?」

name: Momiji
message: 「I didn’t expect such a passionate answer to come back.」

name: Iori
message: 「Were you not satisfied with my answer？」

name: Momiji
message: 「I-I don’t mean it’s bad, exactly, but...」

name: Iori
message: 「But？」

name: Momiji
message: 「Well, I guess it’s fine, isn’t it？」

name: Momiji
message: 「I’m not really interested in that kind of stuff, though.」

name: Momiji
message: 「But if you say so, Teacher... I suppose going along with it could be amusing, nya~」

name: Iori
message: 「I see, thank you for understanding！」
It seems my enthusiasm reached Momiji.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「She said ‘nya~’ at the end. She said ‘nya~’.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「How calculating, Momichi.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Dammit... that was just my usual habit!」

name: Asahi
message: 「Ufufu, Momiji-san is surprisingly cute too.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「So the eldest daughter of the Suzakuin family is just a normal girl underneath.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「No~, Momimomi is just so cute, nya~」

name: Ririmu
message: 「It’s true, nya~」

name: Momiji
message: 「I told you to stop mimicking me！」

name: Momiji
message: 「Anyway, that’s all the questions I have!」

name: Momiji
message: 「Iori-sensei, class is over for today, isn't it！？」

name: Iori
message: 「Yeah, that's right.」
Momiji's expression, which had been so jagged and tense since we got back to the classroom, has softened quite a bit now.
Everyone else was just laughing, as if a weight had been lifted off them.

name: Iori
message: 「Alright Takamura Class, that’s it for today！」

name: Iori
message: 「Be here on time tomorrow as well. Don't be late for class！」

name: Everyone
message: 「Yes!」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Hey, hey, Ririmu-chan, let's stop by the convenience store on the way home!」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Oh, sounds good~, let's go！ Momitchi, are you coming too？」

name: Momiji
message: 「Nah, I’ve still got some snacks left from yesterday.」

name: Asahi
message: 「Oh, that's right. Momiji-san, that non-alcoholic beer you were hiding under your bed was disposed of per Iori-sensei's instructions.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Wait, you’re kidding me, right！？」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Momiji-san... were you drinking things like that at school？」

name: Momiji
message: 「Argh, come on, just give me back one of them~~~~~！」
Momiji's scream echoes through the evening sky.
And so, the hot and intense season for the Takamura Class was about to begin—
